subject: BridgeAI cost options & commitment — follow-up and next steps
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@bridgeai.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap + ask: committed discounts & target $/1M tokens

Hi Elena — great to meet you on the call this morning. Short recap and next steps from our side: 

TL;DR
- BridgeAI is targeting a production pilot for the recommender pipeline starting late Sep.
- Estimated token profile: 50M–200M tokens/month during pilot scaling to 300M+ in year 1.
- Budget: pilot net spend target ~$10k/month; steady-state target is to get unit cost < $1,000 / 1M tokens (ideally closer to $700–$800) with a committed plan.

Notes from the call:
- Use case: low-latency generation + embeddings for hybrid search.
- Concerns: predictable unit economics and ability to reserve capacity (burst + reserved slots).
- Compliance: standard enterprise requirements (SOC2) — you mentioned you can share the security questionnaire next.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I will share a pricing workbook with three scenarios (pay-as-you-go, 6-month commit, 12-month commit + multi-year incentive).
2) Ben (cc) will draft the preliminary unit-econ table and delta to your target $/1M.
3) If these look reasonable, we can put together a draft term sheet and DocuSign-ready quote.

Ben — can you pull a first-pass worksheet (bands and illustrative $/1M) by end of day tomorrow?

Elena — anything I missed, or different numbers you want us to model?

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0186

Thanks Soojin — this is perfect, appreciate the crisp recap. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- Pilot budget: we have roughly $10k/month allocated for a 3-month pilot. If results look good, we can convert to a committed plan.
- Target unit economics: on paper we see $1,200 / 1M tokens today for our current infra, but are aiming for <$800 / 1M with commit.
- Growth profile: month-to-month growth expected ~20–30% after pilot; year 1 avg monthly tokens ~250M.

Questions: 
1) Do you offer the ability to pre-purchase credits (one-time payment that converts to token balance) with an 12–18 month expiration?
2) Any multi-year incentive (rebate or stepped discounts) if we commit to a 2-year ramp?

If you can model: pilot (3mo, 50–100M/mo), 6mo commit (100–200M/mo), 12mo commit (200–300M/mo) and show resulting $/1M net to BridgeAI that would be super helpful.

I can loop in our procurement/billing (billing@bridgeai.io) once we have a formal quote. Open to a follow-up call next week to walk the details.

Best,
Elena Park
Head of Platform | BridgeAI
elena@bridgeai.io

Hi Elena — attaching a first-pass pricing workbook per Soojin's notes (attachment: bridge_pricing_workbook.xlsx). Highlights from the scenarios I modeled: 

Scenarios modeled (summary):
- PAYG: no commitment, list unit $1,200 / 1M tokens (baseline).
- 6-mo commit (monthly avg banded): 20–30% off list depending on committed monthly volume. Example: at 150M/mo -> ~$840 / 1M.
- 12-mo commit + multi-year incentive: up to 40–50% off list for structured multi-year guarantees and purchase timing. Example: at 250M/mo -> ~$660 / 1M.

Other notes:
- Pre-purchase credits: supported; typical expiry we offer is 12 months for standard credits, can extend to 18 months for larger committed purchases (requires finance/legal approval).
- Reserved slots: we can reserve capacity for predictable throughput, with small premium that reduces effective $/1M when combined with commit discounts.
- Multi-year rebate: we can structure a growth-based rebate (e.g., 10% rebate on incremental usage if volume targets hit in year 2) — needs term sheet approval.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Confirm three target bands you want formalized (pilot band, 6-mo band, 12-mo band).
2) If BridgeAI wants pre-purchase expiration >12m or special rebate triggers, we should loop in Marissa (cc) to flag legal/finance early.
3) If acceptable, we'll convert the workbook to a DocuSign-ready quote and term sheet.

Attached: bridge_pricing_workbook.xlsx (spreadsheet, illustrative numbers only).

Ben Carter
Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment: bridge_pricing_workbook.xlsx

From: Elena Park <elena@bridgeai.io>

Subject: Re: Quick recap + ask: committed discounts & target $/1M tokens

Thanks Ben — the workbook is helpful. Two follow-ups from procurement/finance: 

1) Pre-purchase expiry: our preference is 18 months (we have seasonality in Q1 that front-loads usage). Curious what the approval path/time looks like to extend to 18 months.
2) Multi-year incentive: we'd prefer a structured rebate tied to growth milestones (example: 5% rebate at 100% growth YoY, additional 5% at 200% growth). Can Redwood align rebates to measured usage in billing reports?

If you can provide a draft term sheet with the 12-mo and 24-mo options and the pre-purchase expiry alternatives, we can review with procurement and route to DocuSign. Also propose a 30-min call Thursday to walk through scenarios.

Regards,
Elena Park
Head of Platform | BridgeAI
